planets.name: WASP-103 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-103 with a 0.926-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-103 b crosses its star every 0.926 days and is 1.5 Jupiter radii across, found in 2014.
text.introduction: WASP-103 b transits WASP-103 every 0.926 days and is 1.5 Jupiter radii across. Orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GILLON_ET_AL__2014): pl_orbper 0.925542, pl_radj 1.528, pl_bmassj 1.49
